aarti.tek: Victory to Mother Śrī Rāṇī Satī; victory to Satījī, Mother of the world. Take away the misfortune of your devotees.
aarti.pad1: Your own light, unceasing and unbroken, adorns all four quarters; the gleam of your sword, which crushes the wicked, is like lightning. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: The temple of emeralds is most lovely; even the great cannot take in its splendour. Graceful flags fly all around, and golden finials are set upon it. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Bells ring out with a clang, and gongs sound; conches and drums resound; kinnaras sing, and the sound of the Vedas is chanted. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The seven Mothers perform the āratī, and the hosts of gods meditate; dishes of many kinds and coconuts are set before you as offerings. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You tear apart dire troubles; you destroy evil thoughts; on the hearts of your servants you bring gentle good sense. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Your eyes are like the petals of a spotless lotus; you set beings free from the three afflictions. Your servant has come to your refuge: keep his honour, Mother. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Mother Śrī Rāṇī Satī gains success in the home, the nine treasures and the fruit his heart desires. ॥7॥
